source: tools/mcp/program.ts factory.create: useSharedBrowser = sharedBrowserContext || browser.isolated; one shared browser, browser.newContext(contextOptions) per client
dispose callback: while other clients remain, closes only that client's context; the browser closes with the last client
BrowserBackend.callTool: browser_close sets isClose and disposes only its own backend
utils/mcp/http.ts: each streamable-HTTP session (mcp-session-id) creates its own backend through factory.create
